description: Record a channel message on a lead's communications timeline (LinkedIn/WhatsApp/Signal/email/note…). Required: lead_id, channel, body. Optional: direction ('inbound'|'outbound', default inbound), sent_at (ISO), sender, contact_id, external_chat_id, external_message_id, inbound_message_id (the id from list_inbound_messages: sender, sent_at, external_chat_id and external_message_id default to that message's values, and it then counts as assigned). If external_message_id is given and already stored, it is not duplicated (idempotent sync).

channel.description: Channel of the message, e.g. linkedin, whatsapp, email or note

inbound_message_id.description: id of a message from list_inbound_messages; marks it assigned

sender.description: Sender of the message; defaults to the linked inbound message's sender

name: add_lead_message
